research_rationale: Executive Order 12322 of September 17, 1981 (46 FR 46561, September 21, 1981) was read in full from the held Federal Register original (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12322.txt, PDF page 11). The order requires agency water resources reports, proposals and plans to be submitted to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget before they go to Congress (section 1), directs the Director to examine them against three criteria (section 2), requires the advice to accompany later submissions to Congress (section 3) and revokes Executive Order 12113 (section 4). The order has no sunset or expiry. Current law: the U.S. Code release point 119-121 prints the order in full, as amended by EO 12608, as a note to 42 U.S.C. 1962, and the bounded eCFR search reports that 43 CFR 404.51 states that Reclamation's Rural Water Supply Program projects are reviewed under Executive Order 12322 to determine whether each project is consistent with the policies and programs of the President. The only later change is EO 12608 section 31 (52 FR 34617), which replaces the Principles and Standards reference in section 2(b); the Federal Register catalog and held-text number searches show no revocation or supersession of EO 12322. Bounded searches read for coverage before use: current-law:usc covers the U.S. Code release point 119-121 (edition current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted after that date and on or before 2026-10-14 are not reflected); current-law:ecfr covers the eCFR as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML; later-events:ofr_catalog covers Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6942 catalog records (1937 onward) plus operative sentences in 16784 saved order texts. These are machine leads, not independent review; the two-week gap in the U.S. Code edition is disclosed here.
savings_reason: The held text has no savings, transition or pending-action clause. Section 4 revokes EO 12113 without preserving actions under it; that revocation is decided in its own clause row.
earlier_end_check: No earlier end. The order states no end date or condition. The held Federal Register catalog notes and the held-text number search identify only EO 12608 (September 9, 1987), which amends section 2(b), and ordinary citations by the Reclamation rule at 73 FR 67778 and 43 CFR 404.51, which apply the order. Section 2(b) already covers other such planning guidelines as shall hereafter be issued, so later replacement of the named guidelines would not end the clause.
scope_check: Eight clause rows were decided: the lead (authority and purpose recital), sections 1, 2, 2(a), 2(b), 2(c) and 3 (operative; 2(b) amended by EO 12608) and section 4 (revocation of EO 12113, performed on issuance). The lead is carried as an operative recital because the Code prints it with the order.
independent_command_check: Section 4 revokes EO 12113 once, on issuance, independent of the review commands in sections 1 to 3. Sections 1 to 3 are one connected review procedure and none ended separately: the eCFR rule and the Code note treat the whole procedure as current.
savings_check: Savings were checked in the held original text of EO 12322 (sections 1 to 4) and found absent. Section 4 revokes EO 12113 without preserving actions under it, and EO 12608 section 31 contains no savings language affecting EO 12322.
